status_of_the_items.gemma-2-2b-it, llama-3.1-8b-instruct: fresh items inspected in September 2026: declared follow-up, not confirmatory replication
status_of_the_items.qwen2.5-7b-instruct, phi-4-mini-instruct: fresh items never scored on these models: out-of-sample

h1.population: fresh replication: 160 final seeds (80 BBQ templates) and 36 relevant-information control seeds; both sides of every seed; all four models
h1.reference: E_S1(side) = energy of the rank-one span erasure at alpha 1 on that side (sum over layers and span positions of ||h - h'||^2, one pass)
h1.matching: per side, |achieved / target - 1| <= 0.05; a projection capped at alpha 1 is flagged infeasible with its achieved fraction, and the span erasure is scaled down per side to that energy

cells.Rk_span: f 1 (rank 64, exploratory: confounds direction with rank)
cells.P_span@E(P_last), P_span@E(P_ne): span erasure at the energy the site achieved

h1.sites: every site is prefill-only; no cell edits generated tokens
h1.strength_freeze: each side's alpha is solved once on the unpatched prompt, then frozen across candidates, generation and every patching pass
readouts: generation accuracy and validity (deterministic parser; not at f 0.03)

h2.population: gender-flip set of the feedback cycle (72 seeds per model, built by descriptor substitution); gemma-2-2b-it, llama-3.1-8b-instruct
h2.note: the erasure is scaled down per side to the baseline's own energy; the rows of a pair share site and energy but differ in operator AND in fit data and label

h3.population: every eligible mask-clean demographic pair of the 160 pooled test seeds (about 6.5 per seed), four models
cells: first rank-matched random subspace at alpha 1

h4.population: fresh final and control sets, four models
cells: RW (descriptor neutralised in the text; rule per item: name / head / attribute / modifier)
h4.audit: rewritten prompts were read by a person before the run; every control pair stays answerable from the context; 157 of 160 final pairs and 36 of 36 control pairs become identical

margins.justification: 0.02 in accuracy is the September cycle's non-inferiority margin; 0.02 in T is about one seventh of the unedited T; 0.1 in |C_answer| is about one tenth of its unedited mean; each is smaller than the effects the manuscript reports

K1_site_at_equal_energy.statement: At equal total energy on every prompt, T under the span projection is lower than under the control-span, last-token and every-position projections.
K1_site_at_equal_energy.tests: per model, T(other) - T(span) on the final seeds, one-sided (greater), Holm over the three within model. Each comparison uses the span erasure matched to the other cell's achieved energy on each side: P_span@E(P_ne) vs P_ne@1, P_span@E(P_last) vs P_last@1, P_span@1 vs P_all@1. Pairs with both rows present; coverage is reported.
K1_site_at_equal_energy.secondary: the same family on C_answer and at f 0.1

K2_damage_tracks_amount.statement: Every-position projection at the span erasure's total energy leaves generation accuracy within the margin of the UNEDITED model, while the same projection at alpha 1 does not.
K2_damage_tracks_amount.tests: per model, one-sided non-inferiority acc(P_all@1) >= acc(B) - 0.02; acc(B) - acc(P_all@a1) one-sided (greater); the dose curve f 0.1, 1, 10, alpha 1 is reported in full
K2_damage_tracks_amount.reading: this separates total energy from energy per token: a pass says the damage needs far more total removal than the span edit uses, not that position is irrelevant

K3_operator.statement: At the span and equal energy, the contrast vector is non-inferior to the projection on T.
K3_operator.tests: per model, one-sided non-inferiority T(CV_span@1) <= T(P_span@1) + 0.02; control-set accuracy of both reported

K4_leace_equal_energy.statement: At the coherent gender LEACE's own energy, the erasure removes no more dependence than LEACE does.
K4_leace_equal_energy.tests: per model on the gender-flip set, co-primary on T and on |C_answer| (the manuscript's comparison used C_answer): non-superiority of the erasure: P_span@E(b) - b + margin > 0, one-sided (greater), for b in LEACE_gl, MDg, MDf3 and LEACE_f3; Holm over the four within model and readout. A rejection says the erasure does not beat the baseline by more than the margin at equal energy.

K5_selection.statement: The reduction D = mean(|C_pre| - |C_post|) under the span erasure is positive over every eligible demographic pair, not only the selected largest-|C| pair.
K5_selection.tests: per model, one-sided (greater) seed-cluster test of D, for C_raw and C_logp; D(all) / D(selected), the share of pairs with lower |C|, and the quartiles are reported

K6_rewrite.statement: Descriptive, no directional test: how close the edit comes to hiding the term, and what each costs.
K6_rewrite.reports: control-set accuracy of RW, P_span@1 and B; TV(q(P_span@1, a), q(RW, a)) against TV(q(B, a), q(RW, a)); T(RW) on the three pairs whose rewrites differ. T = 0 on identical rewrites is true by construction and is not evidence.

K7_out_of_sample.statement: On Qwen2.5-7B and Phi-4-mini, on items never scored on them, the span erasure lowers T and lowers C_answer.
K7_out_of_sample.tests: per model, T(B) - T(P_span@1) and |C_answer|(B) - |C_answer|(P_span@1), one-sided (greater), Holm over the two within model

K8_scoring.statement: Every T result above is reported on T and on T_mean. A claim is called robust to scoring only if both agree in sign with the T_mean interval excluding zero; otherwise it is stated as specific to the raw-sum readout.
K8_scoring.explanation: h7 attributes the change in option scores to the descriptor's tokens, the shared JSON tokens and the other option tokens, per model

outcome_rules: A hypothesis is supported when its test rejects in the stated direction after Holm within its family; a rejection in the opposite direction is a measured harm and is reported as such; anything else is limited. Every number is reported whichever way it falls. No cell is added, dropped or re-specified after the full runs start without being labelled exploratory.

statistics.bootstrap: studentised, 10,000 resamples, clusters = BBQ template (fresh and gender sets) or seed (pooled pairs)
statistics.correction: Holm within each named family and model
statistics.paired_baseline: all paired tests use this cycle's B rows; drift of B against the September rows is reported

not_in_scope: No weight-space edit, no new model family: the guidance limits a revision to validating existing results.
